watches.name: The Stars at Night
watches.description: The debut release from our "Deep in the Heart" Collection, the Stars at Night captures the essence of those vast, mesmerizing summer skies over Central Texas. Featuring a stunning Aventurine dial, each timepiece is naturally unique. No two dials share the same celestial pattern. Crafted to be a rugged yet elegant heirloom, this watch is designed to be your constant companion through every journey.

watches.name: The Reminder
watches.description: The Reminder is a Limited-Edition Watch that is built for real use. The Reminder is the first-ever release from Forward Watch Co. At the center of each dial is a subtle topographic texture, designed to be noticed only by the person wearing it. The words "Always Forward" aren’t there for show; they exist for one reason: to serve as a reminder when you need it most. When things get bad and shit hits the fan, there’s only one option... Always Move Forward. watches.name: Bluebonnet
watches.description: The third release of our "Deep in the Heart" series. Inspired by the vibrant bluebonnets that transform the Central Texas countryside every spring, this piece features an intricate electroformed dial modeled after the region's topographical landscape. Dynamic Light Play: Because the electroformed surface has micro-faceted variations across the face, ambient light doesn't just hit a flat wall and bounce back. It scatters and catches different ridges at different angles, shifting from a rich indigo in low light to a vivid lupine blue in direct sun. Batch 1 - Estimated to be shipped mid-November

watches.name: The Gonzales
watches.description: The second release of our "Deep in the Heart" collection has arrived. The Gonzales pays tribute to the defiance of 1835, featuring the historic "Come and Take It" cannon front and center against a crisp white linen dial. Featuring a white linen dial encased in a striking black steel border, the design mirrors the textures of the 'Come and Take It' flag. This combination honors the original banner hoisted above the cannon, bringing the spirit of Texan independence to your wrist.
